title: Carriage Agreement — Falcon Freight Pvt Ltd
parties: BlueFin Commerce ("the Customer") and Falcon Freight Pvt Ltd ("the Carrier")
service: full and part truckload road carriage, all-India lanes

clauses.text: Base freight is charged per kilometre of the booked lane distance, according to the consignment's billed weight: - up to and including 500 kg: ₹18.00 per km - 501 kg to 2,000 kg: ₹24.00 per km Consignments above 2,000 kg are quoted case by case and are outside this rate card.
Express service, where booked, carries a premium of 15% of the base freight.
A fuel surcharge of 12% applies to the freight charge (base freight plus express premium, where applicable).
Residential delivery (consignee address is a residence, or the booking is flagged residential): ₹250.00 flat per consignment.

No other accessorial charges are payable under this agreement. Any service outside this schedule requires the Customer's written agreement in advance, evidenced by a rate confirmation referencing this agreement.
The Carrier invoices fortnightly. Payment is due 30 days from invoice date.
Billing disputes must be raised within 45 days of invoice date. Disputed line items are payable only on resolution; undisputed items remain due.
The Carrier may issue credit notes correcting earlier invoices. A credit note references the original consignment note number and states the invoice it corrects.
